notes: IWE001 is the currently extracted strict-H1 mutualist programme; its three site effects are dependent and count as one programme. IWE004 and IWE005 were source-adjudicated to timing/context lanes.

IWE068 is the first quantitatively closed strict antagonist programme: pinned Maxfield 2021 raw data reconstruct n=11, Fisher z=-0.0522967173, variance=0.125 under the frozen leave-one-out overlap contract. IWE035 and IWE067 remain unresolved strict bridges. IWE032-IWE034 remain nonlinear/bidirectional shape evidence.

IWE064 is the first quantitatively closed strict mixed programme; IWE059 remains unresolved-strict. IWE066 is preregistered-H2 interior-peak shape evidence without a formal numerical curvature coefficient. IWE065 is a benefit-channel-only effect and remains outside net mixed H1.
